data.name: Promo Wrestling World
data.detailed_description:
Current Build Status

Promo Wrestling World is out now! With that said, expect ongoing balance changes, bug fixes, and expanded features. I'm always listening to the players. 

You're the owner, general manager, or the booker. Your choice!

Promo Wrestling World aims to be the most customizable wrestling management game on the market. The goal is if you can dream it, you can do it!

You are in charge of your own wrestling promotion. You run the company week by week, from booking television and major events to signing talent, managing contracts, dealing with injuries, and keeping the locker room under control.

Push the right wrestler, and you could create your next franchise star. Back the wrong one, mishandle a contract, or lose control of your payroll, and the whole promotion can fall apart.

Key Features

• Draft an entire wrestling world. In World Draft mode, every promotion starts with an empty roster. Scout the available talent, build your draft board, make your picks live, and watch rival companies put their own rosters together.

• Start with almost nothing. Founder mode lets you build a promotion from the ground up. Find a place to run, put together a roster, survive the early years, and try to turn a small operation into a major company.

• Watch the show happen. Your cards do not disappear into a results screen. Watch Live presents the entrances, matches, near-falls, interference, injuries, crowd reactions, and title changes as they happen.

• Call the matches yourself. Plug in a microphone and do your own play-by-play during Watch Live. Your color commentator can respond using the wrestlers, championships, and history from your save. Local voice mode runs entirely on your PC.

• Book more than a list of matches. Put together promos, interviews, beatdowns, run-ins, saves, betrayals, turns, title matches, tournaments, and long-running storylines. Build the weekly television that leads to the match people actually want to see.

• Create your own match types. Use the Match Lab to build special matches, set the rules, choose where the action can go, decide how the match ends, and save your creation for future shows.

• Deal with a world that keeps moving. Rival promotions sign wrestlers, lose stars, compete for television and audiences, raid rosters, make trades, grow, struggle, merge, and sometimes fold. New promotions and new wrestlers can enter the industry as the years pass.

• Handle the people behind the show. Wrestlers remember how they are treated. Morale, trust, personality, relationships, injuries, backstage roles, tag-team chemistry, and stable loyalty can all affect your plans.

• Run the wrestling business. Negotiate contracts and television deals, manage payroll, sell tickets and merchandise, find sponsors, choose venues, and decide how much you can afford to spend on production.

• Make championships mean something. Titles track every champion, reign, defense, vacancy, and change in prestige. The game also keeps a contender picture so you can see who has earned the next shot.

• Build a history worth remembering. Follow careers, records, awards, Hall of Fame candidates, major feuds, title lineages, and the story of your promotion across a long-term save.

• Play in different eras. The wrestling business changes depending on when you start. Media, money, fan expectations, and the way promotions compete all reflect the era you choose.

• Build the world you want. The World Editor gives you control over promotions, wrestlers, staff, championships, teams, stables, relationships, regions, venues, match types, media, and so much more! A true database builder's dream. 

• Database Converter. Easily import your custom database from other games (more to be added).

Promo Wrestling World is for wrestling fans who want more than a card simulator. It is about booking the show, running the company, dealing with the consequences, and seeing what kind of wrestling world you create.

data.short_description: The most customizable wrestling management game is in your hands. Run or build your wrestling promotion. Sign talent, book matches and storylines, build stars, and watch rivals grow, wrestlers grow old, have kids, and their bloodline continue on.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or dedicated GPU with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU or modern integrated graphics with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
